column1: W10^Umbral Tempest^B^Blizzard^B–A^5^Fires burn without casting light
column2: giving heat and nothing else.

column1: W10^Umbral Tempest^B^Blizzard^B–A^6^Shield domes go black and the cities inside them lose all sense of time.
W10^Umbral Tempest^B^Blizzard^B–A^7^Anything reflective stops reflecting; mirrors and water surfaces read as flat black.
W10^Umbral Tempest^B^Blizzard^B–A^8^Monsters that fear light are drawn in from surrounding regions and pack into the dark.
W10^Umbral Tempest^B^Blizzard^B–A^9^Distance is unjudgeable; a wall at arm's length and a ridge at a mile feel identical.
W10^Umbral Tempest^B^Blizzard^B–A^10^Sound becomes the only navigation
column2: and every drifter starts counting paces aloud.

column1: W10^Umbral Tempest^B^Blizzard^B–A^11^Vegetation wilts within hours as though a season of darkness passed in one afternoon.
W10^Umbral Tempest^B^Blizzard^B–A^12^The darkness pools in low ground first
column2: filling valleys before it takes the ridges.

column1: W10^Umbral Tempest^B^Blizzard^B–A^13^Signal fires and lamps are useless for communication
column2: and whole caravans lose contact.

column1: W10^Umbral Tempest^B^Blizzard^B–A^14^Livestock go completely docile
column2: standing still and silent wherever the dark caught them.

column1: W10^Umbral Tempest^B^Blizzard^B–A^15^Anything carried into the tempest lit stays warm to the touch afterward
column2: and dimmer than before.

column1: W10^Umbral Tempest^B^Blizzard^B–A^16^The edges of the storm are hard
column2: not gradual — you step from full daylight into nothing.

column1: W10^Umbral Tempest^B^Blizzard^B–A^17^Datasphere nodes report the region as unmapped for the duration.
W10^Umbral Tempest^B^Blizzard^B–A^18^Shardlight batteries drain at ten times the normal rate and cannot be recharged inside.
W10^Umbral Tempest^B^Blizzard^B–A^19^Afterward
column2: the returning daylight is painful and everyone in the region is half-blind for an hour.

column1: W10^Umbral Tempest^B^Blizzard^B–A^20^Things are found in the open afterward that were locked inside buildings before it started.
W11^Flat Rain^B^Blizzard^B–A^1^Rain travels horizontally with enough force to strip bark
column2: paint and skin from any exposed face.

column1: W11^Flat Rain^B^Blizzard^B–A^2^One enormous cloud draws water from every other cloud in the sky
column2: visibly emptying them.

column1: W11^Flat Rain^B^Blizzard^B–A^3^Windward walls are scoured back to bare material within an hour.
W11^Flat Rain^B^Blizzard^B–A^4^Nothing pools on the ground; the water simply keeps moving across it and away.
W11^Flat Rain^B^Blizzard^B–A^5^Shelter only works if it faces the right direction
column2: and the direction shifts without warning.

column1: W11^Flat Rain^B^Blizzard^B–A^6^Wounds open on anything caught in the open
column2: and blood is carried away as fast as it appears.

column1: W11^Flat Rain^B^Blizzard^B–A^7^Whole hillsides are stripped of topsoil laterally
column2: exposing root systems and buried structures.

column1: W11^Flat Rain^B^Blizzard^B–A^8^Signage
column2: markers and route stones are sandblasted illegible in a single storm.

column1: W11^Flat Rain^B^Blizzard^B–A^9^Monsters fight each other across the region rather than hunting
column2: and the pattern repeats.

column1: W11^Flat Rain^B^Blizzard^B–A^10^Doors and shutters on the windward side are forced inward regardless of how they are barred.
W11^Flat Rain^B^Blizzard^B–A^11^Standing water is driven uphill along the slope of the land.
W11^Flat Rain^B^Blizzard^B–A^12^Trees bend and stay bent
column2: and the whole region grows permanently leaning afterward.

column1: W11^Flat Rain^B^Blizzard^B–A^13^The sound is a continuous hiss rather than a drumming
column2: and it does not vary.

column1: W11^Flat Rain^B^Blizzard^B–A^14^Anything with a broad surface — tarps
column2: sails

column1: W11^Flat Rain^B^Blizzard^B–A^15^Livestock are driven against fencing and pile up there until the fencing gives.
W11^Flat Rain^B^Blizzard^B–A^16^Shield domes deform visibly under the pressure and the surface ripples.
W11^Flat Rain^B^Blizzard^B–A^17^Old graves and shallow burials are opened along exposed slopes.
W11^Flat Rain^B^Blizzard^B–A^18^The rain carries grit
column2: and everything it touches ends up polished and slightly abraded.

column1: W11^Flat Rain^B^Blizzard^B–A^19^Fires cannot be lit anywhere in the open
column2: including inside anything with a windward opening.

column1: W11^Flat Rain^B^Blizzard^B–A^20^Afterward
column2: the land looks combed — every loose thing lying in the same direction.

column1: W12^Psionic Storm^B^Blizzard^D–A^1^A rainbow shimmer crosses the sky with no rain
column2: and the air develops a pressure behind the eyes.

column1: W12^Psionic Storm^B^Blizzard^D–A^2^Animals across the region behave wrongly: predators grazing
column2: herd beasts turning to face the storm.

column1: W12^Psionic Storm^B^Blizzard^D–A^3^Datasphere traffic garbles into fragments of speech nobody transmitted.
W12^Psionic Storm^B^Blizzard^D–A^4^Hallucinations are shared — two people describe the same thing that is not there.
W12^Psionic Storm^B^Blizzard^D–A^5^Every drifter in the region reports the same buzzing note at the same pitch.
W12^Psionic Storm^B^Blizzard^D–A^6^Written records change while unattended
column2: and nobody can prove they were different before.

column1: W12^Psionic Storm^B^Blizzard^D–A^7^Monsters of every tier appear simultaneously
column2: from wolf to Calamity

column1: W12^Psionic Storm^B^Blizzard^D–A^8^Old memories surface with total clarity while recent ones become unreliable.
W12^Psionic Storm^B^Blizzard^D–A^9^Structures feel wrong in their proportions; corridors seem longer walking one way than the other.
W12^Psionic Storm^B^Blizzard^D–A^10^Psionic dampeners overheat and fail within an hour of exposure.
W12^Psionic Storm^B^Blizzard^D–A^11^Latent abilities awaken in one person in a hundred
column2: usually violently.

column1: W12^Psionic Storm^B^Blizzard^D–A^12^Livestock go mute; not silent by choice
column2: but unable to make sound at all.

column1: W12^Psionic Storm^B^Blizzard^D–A^13^Sleepers in the region share a dream and wake within a minute of each other.
W12^Psionic Storm^B^Blizzard^D–A^14^Navigation fails as landmarks read as familiar regardless of whether they are.
W12^Psionic Storm^B^Blizzard^D–A^15^Objects are moved without contact
column2: slowly

column1: W12^Psionic Storm^B^Blizzard^D–A^16^The storm has no physical footprint — the ground afterward is entirely undisturbed.
W12^Psionic Storm^B^Blizzard^D–A^17^Speech becomes difficult; people reach for words and retrieve the wrong ones.
W12^Psionic Storm^B^Blizzard^D–A^18^Anyone who has been struck before feels the approach hours ahead of the shimmer.
W12^Psionic Storm^B^Blizzard^D–A^19^Divisions form fast among groups sheltering together
column2: over nothing anyone can later name.

column1: W12^Psionic Storm^B^Blizzard^D–A^20^Afterward
column2: the region reports missing time — a few minutes

column1: W13^Shadowstorms^A^Avalanche^D–C^1^Shadows lengthen far past what the light angle allows
column2: and keep lengthening.

column1: W13^Shadowstorms^A^Avalanche^D–C^2^Lights flicker across the whole district and no source can be found for the interference.
W13^Shadowstorms^A^Avalanche^D–C^3^Electronic equipment corrupts rather than fails
column2: returning wrong answers confidently.

column1: W13^Shadowstorms^A^Avalanche^D–C^4^Animals fall completely silent
column2: and the silence spreads outward ahead of the storm.

column1: W13^Shadowstorms^A^Avalanche^D–C^5^Apparitions move at the edge of vision and resolve into nothing when approached directly.
W13^Shadowstorms^A^Avalanche^D–C^6^Visibility drops to a few paces
column2: but the darkness is textured rather than empty.

column1: W13^Shadowstorms^A^Avalanche^D–C^7^Shadows detach from their objects and remain when the object is moved.
W13^Shadowstorms^A^Avalanche^D–C^8^Divine artifacts glow steadily and are the only reliable light in the region.
W13^Shadowstorms^A^Avalanche^D–C^9^Doors are found open that were locked
column2: and closed that were propped.

column1: W13^Shadowstorms^A^Avalanche^D–C^10^Reflections lag behind their subjects by a fraction of a second.
W13^Shadowstorms^A^Avalanche^D–C^11^Actual monster activity stays low
column2: which makes every drifter more nervous rather than less.

column1: W13^Shadowstorms^A^Avalanche^D–C^12^Names are heard called from empty ground
column2: correctly and in familiar voices.

column1: W13^Shadowstorms^A^Avalanche^D–C^13^Shield generators report intrusions continuously and nothing is ever found.
W13^Shadowstorms^A^Avalanche^D–C^14^Cold spots move through buildings on their own paths
column2: unrelated to doors or drafts.

column1: W13^Shadowstorms^A^Avalanche^D–C^15^Written notes and route markings are altered subtly and legibly.
W13^Shadowstorms^A^Avalanche^D–C^16^Fires burn low and blue regardless of fuel.
W13^Shadowstorms^A^Avalanche^D–C^17^Anyone left alone reports company; anyone in a group reports being watched from outside it.
W13^Shadowstorms^A^Avalanche^D–C^18^The storm leaves no residue
column2: no damage
column3: and no evidence of having occurred.

column1: W13^Shadowstorms^A^Avalanche^D–C^19^Dogs will not enter affected buildings and cannot be made to.
W13^Shadowstorms^A^Avalanche^D–C^20^Afterward
column2: the region's records disagree with everyone's memory of the same three days.

column1: W14^Chrono Fog^A^Avalanche^D–A^1^Clocks in the region disagree with each other and with themselves minute to minute.
W14^Chrono Fog^A^Avalanche^D–A^2^Fog banks sit in distinct zones
column2: and time runs at a different rate inside each.

column1: W14^Chrono Fog^A^Avalanche^D–A^3^Ghost images of past events replay in place: carts that are not there
column2: fires long out.

column1: W14^Chrono Fog^A^Avalanche^D–A^4^Vegetation ages or reverts within a single zone — saplings and deadfall side by side.
W14^Chrono Fog^A^Avalanche^D–A^5^Datasphere timestamps arrive from several different eras at once.
W14^Chrono Fog^A^Avalanche^D–A^6^Ruins appear briefly intact
column2: complete with their original signage

column1: W14^Chrono Fog^A^Avalanche^D–A^7^A person walking a straight line emerges older or younger than the person beside them.
W14^Chrono Fog^A^Avalanche^D–A^8^Food spoils or unspoils depending on which pocket of fog it is carried through.
W14^Chrono Fog^A^Avalanche^D–A^9^Sound arrives out of order; a shout is heard after its echo.
W14^Chrono Fog^A^Avalanche^D–A^10^Time Wraiths circle the densest zones and are visible as distortions rather than shapes.
W14^Chrono Fog^A^Avalanche^D–A^11^Structures show wear from centuries that have not happened yet.
W14^Chrono Fog^A^Avalanche^D–A^12^Anything left in the fog overnight is found weathered by decades or restored to new.
W14^Chrono Fog^A^Avalanche^D–A^13^Footprints appear ahead of the party on untrodden ground
column2: in their own boots.

column1: W14^Chrono Fog^A^Avalanche^D–A^14^Wounds close and reopen as the bearer moves between zones.
W14^Chrono Fog^A^Avalanche^D–A^15^The fog does not drift with the wind and cannot be dispersed.
W14^Chrono Fog^A^Avalanche^D–A^16^Bodies are found from expeditions that have not yet set out.
W14^Chrono Fog^A^Avalanche^D–A^17^Fires burn down to ash in seconds or refuse to consume fuel at all.
W14^Chrono Fog^A^Avalanche^D–A^18^The region's maps become unreliable as roads revert to earlier alignments.
W14^Chrono Fog^A^Avalanche^D–A^19^Someone always emerges who has been missing for years and does not know it.
W14^Chrono Fog^A^Avalanche^D–A^20^Afterward the fog lifts instantly
column2: and everything inside is left at whatever age it reached.

column1: W15^Volcanic Storm^A^Avalanche^C–S^1^The ground vibrates for days beforehand
column2: and the tremor is felt before anything is seen.

column1: W15^Volcanic Storm^A^Avalanche^C–S^2^Sulfur smell saturates the region and clings to water
column2: food and cloth.

column1: W15^Volcanic Storm^A^Avalanche^C–S^3^Ash falls thick enough to bury roads
column2: and every landmark below head height disappears.

column1: W15^Volcanic Storm^A^Avalanche^C–S^4^Magma rain sets fires wherever it lands
column2: and the fires spread faster than anyone can respond.

column1: W15^Volcanic Storm^A^Avalanche^C–S^5^The sky goes brick-red at midday and stays that colour into the night.
W15^Volcanic Storm^A^Avalanche^C–S^6^Geysers activate across the district
column2: including in places with no prior thermal activity.

column1: W15^Volcanic Storm^A^Avalanche^C–S^7^Rivers run warm
column2: then hot

column1: W15^Volcanic Storm^A^Avalanche^C–S^8^Pyroclastic flows follow valley floors
column2: which are exactly the routes carts must use.

column1: W15^Volcanic Storm^A^Avalanche^C–S^9^Ash buries vegetation and smothers it; whole forests are lost standing upright.
W15^Volcanic Storm^A^Avalanche^C–S^10^Breathing becomes the primary problem
column2: and unsealed shelter is no shelter at all.

column1: W15^Volcanic Storm^A^Avalanche^C–S^11^Structures collapse under ash load rather than burning
column2: roofs first.

column1: W15^Volcanic Storm^A^Avalanche^C–S^12^Apocalypse-tier fire entities emerge from the vents and move outward from them.
W15^Volcanic Storm^A^Avalanche^C–S^13^Water sources are poisoned by ashfall and cannot be filtered clean.
W15^Volcanic Storm^A^Avalanche^C–S^14^Metal softens where it is exposed and blades taken through the region come out warped.
W15^Volcanic Storm^A^Avalanche^C–S^15^Visibility is measured in paces and the ash blocks light entirely at midday.
W15^Volcanic Storm^A^Avalanche^C–S^16^New ground forms as flows cool
column2: and the map is wrong afterward in permanent ways.

column1: W15^Volcanic Storm^A^Avalanche^C–S^17^Livestock suffocate before they burn
column2: and the losses are total across the region.

column1: W15^Volcanic Storm^A^Avalanche^C–S^18^Shield domes hold heat in and the cities beneath them become ovens.
W15^Volcanic Storm^A^Avalanche^C–S^19^Static builds in the ash cloud and lightning plays through it constantly.
W15^Volcanic Storm^A^Avalanche^C–S^20^Afterward the region is grey
column2: level and silent
column3: and stays that way for years.

column1: W16^Anti-Gravity Vortex^A^Avalanche^A–S+^1^Small objects begin drifting upward hours before anything else happens.
W16^Anti-Gravity Vortex^A^Avalanche^A–S+^2^Water leaves its basins and rises in coherent columns and spheres.
W16^Anti-Gravity Vortex^A^Avalanche^A–S+^3^Metallic objects accelerate upward and become high-velocity projectiles in every direction.
W16^Anti-Gravity Vortex^A^Avalanche^A–S+^4^A low hum saturates the region and is felt in the chest rather than heard.
W16^Anti-Gravity Vortex^A^Avalanche^A–S+^5^Animals levitate helplessly and are killed by the debris rather than the fall.
W16^Anti-Gravity Vortex^A^Avalanche^A–S+^6^Topsoil
column2: gravel and loose stone lift as a single layer

column1: W16^Anti-Gravity Vortex^A^Avalanche^A–S+^7^Buildings come apart upward
column2: roofs first

column1: W16^Anti-Gravity Vortex^A^Avalanche^A–S+^8^Anything tethered with metal cable is destroyed as the cable becomes the weapon.
W16^Anti-Gravity Vortex^A^Avalanche^A–S+^9^Dust and debris orbit at altitude in a visible ring around the vortex eye.
W16^Anti-Gravity Vortex^A^Avalanche^A–S+^10^Fires burn as spheres and consume their fuel from the outside in.
W16^Anti-Gravity Vortex^A^Avalanche^A–S+^11^Blood pools wrongly
column2: and injuries in the region behave in ways no field medic expects.

column1: W16^Anti-Gravity Vortex^A^Avalanche^A–S+^12^Cataclysmic-tier creatures are documented inside the eye and appear entirely unaffected.
W16^Anti-Gravity Vortex^A^Avalanche^A–S+^13^Shield domes invert their curvature and the generators tear free of their foundations.
W16^Anti-Gravity Vortex^A^Avalanche^A–S+^14^Sound travels oddly
column2: arriving from above regardless of the source's position.

column1: W16^Anti-Gravity Vortex^A^Avalanche^A–S+^15^Buried wreckage from before the Scarring is lifted intact into open air.
W16^Anti-Gravity Vortex^A^Avalanche^A–S+^16^Anything that goes up comes down when the vortex passes
column2: over a wide and unpredictable area.

column1: W16^Anti-Gravity Vortex^A^Avalanche^A–S+^17^The eye is calm
column2: and drifters who reach it report perfect stillness and no gravity at all.

column1: W16^Anti-Gravity Vortex^A^Avalanche^A–S+^18^Loose ordnance and old munitions rise
column2: collide and detonate at height.

column1: W16^Anti-Gravity Vortex^A^Avalanche^A–S+^19^Rivers empty upward and the beds are left dry and scoured to stone.
W16^Anti-Gravity Vortex^A^Avalanche^A–S+^20^Afterward the region is littered with everything the vortex held
column2: dropped from a great height.

column1: W17^Necrotic Shroud^A^Avalanche^A–S^1^Plants wither in visible waves as the fog front advances across open ground.
W17^Necrotic Shroud^A^Avalanche^A–S^2^The fog is greenish
column2: cold
column4: pooling in cellars and low ground first.

column1: W17^Necrotic Shroud^A^Avalanche^A–S^3^Every animal capable of leaving has left before the shroud arrives.
W17^Necrotic Shroud^A^Avalanche^A–S^4^Voices of the dead are audible
column2: speaking normally
column3: in languages the region no longer uses.

column1: W17^Necrotic Shroud^A^Avalanche^A–S^5^Datasphere signals stop entirely inside the fog
column2: with no static and no error — just absence.

column1: W17^Necrotic Shroud^A^Avalanche^A–S^6^Living tissue degrades on prolonged contact
column2: starting with the extremities.

column1: W17^Necrotic Shroud^A^Avalanche^A–S^7^Undead already present are empowered and multiply
column2: and burial grounds do not stay closed.

column1: W17^Necrotic Shroud^A^Avalanche^A–S^8^The smell of decay is present without any source that can be found.
W17^Necrotic Shroud^A^Avalanche^A–S^9^Water sources go stagnant within hours regardless of flow rate.
W17^Necrotic Shroud^A^Avalanche^A–S^10^Divine artifacts burn bright and clear here
column2: and are the only reliable defence.

column1: W17^Necrotic Shroud^A^Avalanche^A–S^11^Food stores spoil through sealed containers.
W17^Necrotic Shroud^A^Avalanche^A–S^12^Wounds refuse to close and old scars split open along their original lines.
W17^Necrotic Shroud^A^Avalanche^A–S^13^Fires burn but give almost no heat.
W17^Necrotic Shroud^A^Avalanche^A–S^14^Structures rot at accelerated rates — timber goes soft
column2: mortar crumbles

column1: W17^Necrotic Shroud^A^Avalanche^A–S^15^The fog does not disperse in wind and moves against it when it moves at all.
W17^Necrotic Shroud^A^Avalanche^A–S^16^Anyone who dies inside the shroud does not stay down for long.
W17^Necrotic Shroud^A^Avalanche^A–S^17^Shield domes filter it partially
column2: and the cities beneath report a thin green haze at street level.

column1: W17^Necrotic Shroud^A^Avalanche^A–S^18^Sound is deadened; shouting carries no further than speaking.
W17^Necrotic Shroud^A^Avalanche^A–S^19^The dead speak to specific people by name
column2: and only they can hear it.

column1: W17^Necrotic Shroud^A^Avalanche^A–S^20^Afterward the ground is barren for a season and nothing planted in it takes.
W18^Glass Rain^A^Avalanche^A–S^1^A faint tinkling arrives on the wind minutes before anything falls.
W18^Glass Rain^A^Avalanche^A–S^2^The sky develops a hard glassy shimmer and the sun refracts into fragments across it.
W18^Glass Rain^A^Avalanche^A–S^3^Probe shards fall first — small
column2: sparse
column3: and easy to mistake for hail.

column1: W18^Glass Rain^A^Avalanche^A–S^4^Microscopic shards hang in the air and enter the lungs of anything breathing unfiltered.
W18^Glass Rain^A^Avalanche^A–S^5^Building-sized panels fall intact and shatter on impact
column2: clearing everything within a hundred paces.

column1: W18^Glass Rain^A^Avalanche^A–S^6^Actual diamonds fall among the glass
column2: and the ground afterward is genuinely valuable.

column1: W18^Glass Rain^A^Avalanche^A–S^7^The smell of hot sand saturates the region before the first shard lands.
W18^Glass Rain^A^Avalanche^A–S^8^Roads become impassable to anything without sealed tyres or tracks.
W18^Glass Rain^A^Avalanche^A–S^9^Vegetation is shredded to stubble and the ground glitters where it stood.
W18^Glass Rain^A^Avalanche^A–S^10^Water sources fill with suspended glass and cannot be drunk from at all.
W18^Glass Rain^A^Avalanche^A–S^11^Livestock die from inhalation days later
column2: long after the storm has passed.

column1: W18^Glass Rain^A^Avalanche^A–S^12^Light refracts unpredictably off the accumulated shards
column2: and the region becomes blinding at dawn.

column1: W18^Glass Rain^A^Avalanche^A–S^13^Shield domes are scoured to opacity and must be replaced rather than cleaned.
W18^Glass Rain^A^Avalanche^A–S^14^Structures survive but every window
column2: lens and shardlight housing in the region is destroyed.

column1: W18^Glass Rain^A^Avalanche^A–S^15^Salvagers arrive within a day and die at a predictable rate collecting diamonds.
W18^Glass Rain^A^Avalanche^A–S^16^Apocalypse-tier creatures move through unharmed
column2: and the shards break against them.

column1: W18^Glass Rain^A^Avalanche^A–S^17^Sound is sharp and glittering and carries badly over the accumulated debris.
W18^Glass Rain^A^Avalanche^A–S^18^Anything soft-sided is destroyed; tents
column2: tarps and canvas caravans are total losses.

column1: W18^Glass Rain^A^Avalanche^A–S^19^The accumulated glass shifts underfoot for weeks afterward and cuts through boot leather.
W18^Glass Rain^A^Avalanche^A–S^20^The region is left beautiful
column2: lethal
column3: and impossible to cross on foot for a season.

column1: W19^Waterfall Shower^A^Avalanche^A–S^1^The environment feels unnaturally dry in the hours before
column2: and everyone's throat goes rough.

column1: W19^Waterfall Shower^A^Avalanche^A–S^2^It begins like ordinary rain and gives no other warning at all.

W19^Waterfall Shower^A^Avalanche^A–S^4^The falls move across the landscape
column2: so static shelter is no protection.

column1: W19^Waterfall Shower^A^Avalanche^A–S^5^Impact zones are flattened completely — structures
column2: trees and terrain features alike.

column1: W19^Waterfall Shower^A^Avalanche^A–S^6^Flash floods run in every direction at once
column2: following no drainage that makes sense.

column1: W19^Waterfall Shower^A^Avalanche^A–S^7^Dry riverbeds fill and overtop within minutes and change course permanently.
W19^Waterfall Shower^A^Avalanche^A–S^8^The noise makes communication impossible beyond arm's length.
W19^Waterfall Shower^A^Avalanche^A–S^9^Monsters go into a frenzy and attack everything
column2: including each other.

column1: W19^Waterfall Shower^A^Avalanche^A–S^10^Ground saturates instantly and anything heavy sinks where it stands.
W19^Waterfall Shower^A^Avalanche^A–S^11^Debris rafts form and travel miles
column2: carrying wreckage and bodies into new districts.

column1: W19^Waterfall Shower^A^Avalanche^A–S^12^Bridges and fords are removed entirely
column2: and the region is cut into isolated pockets.

column1: W19^Waterfall Shower^A^Avalanche^A–S^13^Cellars
column2: mines and tunnels fill top to bottom without warning.

column1: W19^Waterfall Shower^A^Avalanche^A–S^14^The falls leave circular scours in bedrock that stay visible for generations.

W19^Waterfall Shower^A^Avalanche^A–S^17^Livestock drown in open ground

column1: W19^Waterfall Shower^A^Avalanche^A–S^18^Apocalypse-tier creatures fight openly and the region becomes a battlefield nobody chose.
W19^Waterfall Shower^A^Avalanche^A–S^19^Between falls there are minutes of complete calm
column2: which lures people out.

column1: W19^Waterfall Shower^A^Avalanche^A–S^20^Afterward the region is scoured
column2: reshaped
column3: and littered with whatever the water carried.

column1: W20^Cosmic Storm^S^Scarring^A–S+^1^The horizon appears to shatter
column2: and by the time it is visible the storm has already begun.

column1: W20^Cosmic Storm^S^Scarring^A–S+^2^Objects
column2: creatures and whole landscape features appear and vanish without transition.

column1: W20^Cosmic Storm^S^Scarring^A–S+^3^Terrain rearranges — a ridge stands where a valley was and the road ends in open air.
W20^Cosmic Storm^S^Scarring^A–S+^4^Colours occur that nobody in the party can name or agree on.
W20^Cosmic Storm^S^Scarring^A–S+^5^Gravity
column2: light and sound each stop behaving consistently

column1: W20^Cosmic Storm^S^Scarring^A–S+^6^Structures exist in two states at once and are dangerous to enter in either.
W20^Cosmic Storm^S^Scarring^A–S+^7^The storm cannot be flown around
column2: tunnelled under

column1: W20^Cosmic Storm^S^Scarring^A–S+^8^Three tiers of monster emerge together
column2: and the largest ignore the others entirely.

column1: W20^Cosmic Storm^S^Scarring^A–S+^9^Datasphere nodes report the region as multiple contradictory locations simultaneously.
W20^Cosmic Storm^S^Scarring^A–S+^10^Water runs in directions unrelated to slope.
W20^Cosmic Storm^S^Scarring^A–S+^11^People are separated by a few paces and lose each other completely.
W20^Cosmic Storm^S^Scarring^A–S+^12^Shield domes fail in ways their engineers cannot afterward explain or reproduce.
W20^Cosmic Storm^S^Scarring^A–S+^13^Things that were destroyed years ago stand whole
column2: and are solid to the touch.

column1: W20^Cosmic Storm^S^Scarring^A–S+^14^Distance stops being reliable; a hundred paces takes an hour or a heartbeat.
W20^Cosmic Storm^S^Scarring^A–S+^15^The sky shows constellations that do not exist and the three moons in the wrong order.
W20^Cosmic Storm^S^Scarring^A–S+^16^Fires burn without fuel and cannot be extinguished.
W20^Cosmic Storm^S^Scarring^A–S+^17^Anything left behind is not there afterward
column2: and anything abandoned elsewhere may be.

column1: W20^Cosmic Storm^S^Scarring^A–S+^18^The storm's edge is visible as a hard line and does not move predictably.
W20^Cosmic Storm^S^Scarring^A–S+^19^Survivors describe entirely different events in the same location at the same time.
W20^Cosmic Storm^S^Scarring^A–S+^20^Afterward the region is subtly wrong
column2: and cartographers argue for years about what changed.

column1: W21^Dimensional Scars^S^Scarring^Any–S+^1^It begins as ordinary rain
column2: which is why so many caravans are caught by it.

column1: W21^Dimensional Scars^S^Scarring^Any–S+^2^Closed portals appear on walls
column2: floors
column3: cart-beds and open ground as dark seams.

column1: W21^Dimensional Scars^S^Scarring^Any–S+^3^The seams open in sequence
column2: and the sound is the same each time.

column1: W21^Dimensional Scars^S^Scarring^Any–S+^4^Creatures emerge continuously from every rift
column2: of any tier

column1: W21^Dimensional Scars^S^Scarring^Any–S+^5^Air from elsewhere comes through — wrong temperature
column2: wrong smell

column1: W21^Dimensional Scars^S^Scarring^Any–S+^6^Light from the rifts falls in colours that do not match the sky above them.
W21^Dimensional Scars^S^Scarring^Any–S+^7^The ground around each scar is scorched
column2: frozen or crystallised depending on what lies beyond.

column1: W21^Dimensional Scars^S^Scarring^Any–S+^8^Rifts open inside structures
column2: and buildings become the most dangerous place to shelter.

column1: W21^Dimensional Scars^S^Scarring^Any–S+^9^The largest creatures cannot fit through
column2: and can be heard trying.

column1: W21^Dimensional Scars^S^Scarring^Any–S+^10^Navigation is impossible; movement in any direction crosses more rifts than it avoids.
W21^Dimensional Scars^S^Scarring^Any–S+^11^Shield domes are penetrated from inside
column2: as scars open within the perimeter.

column1: W21^Dimensional Scars^S^Scarring^Any–S+^12^Objects fall through from elsewhere: wreckage
column2: bones
column3: and things with no reference in any record.

column1: W21^Dimensional Scars^S^Scarring^Any–S+^13^Rifts close as suddenly as they open
column2: sometimes with something halfway through.

column1: W21^Dimensional Scars^S^Scarring^Any–S+^14^Vegetation near a scar mutates within hours into forms that seed and spread.
W21^Dimensional Scars^S^Scarring^Any–S+^15^The Datasphere floods with data from sources that do not exist.
W21^Dimensional Scars^S^Scarring^Any–S+^16^Water drains through open scars and whole reservoirs empty into elsewhere.
W21^Dimensional Scars^S^Scarring^Any–S+^17^Sound comes back through the rifts delayed and distorted
column2: in voices from the other side.

column1: W21^Dimensional Scars^S^Scarring^Any–S+^18^Even Awakened and high-tier drifters shelter rather than fight; the numbers are simply wrong.
W21^Dimensional Scars^S^Scarring^Any–S+^19^The region afterward holds permanent scar sites that reopen on no schedule anyone has found.
W21^Dimensional Scars^S^Scarring^Any–S+^20^Every new Dimensional Scar adds to the world's monster population permanently.
